dataList.content:
The Grand Magasin must be consumed.
百货店必须持续消费。

Even if all must eat without pause.
人人都源源不断地进食。

Some hope that this moment would never end,
有人期盼这瞬间永不终结。

Wishing that the filling would last forever,
期盼这逐渐充实的满足感永不终结。

Now everyone in this department store has turned into a pure consumer. They consume without restraint.
百货店内的大家如今如同脱缰一般，只顾着消费。

There's nobody left to create things.
再也无人创造。

They will all eat, wear, excrete, and consume.
只是进食，裹身，排泄，消费而已。

They will start with their enemies—Le Noir, Le Kaki, and others who do not belong to the Rouges.
一开始只是进食黑派或褐派那些所属不同的人。

And once there is no one left to eat, they will eat each other.
可一旦其他食物被吞噬一空，最终会演变成互相啃食吧。

This has become a momentum that cannot be stopped.
这份惯性已经无法停止了。

They will continue devouring each other until only a single existence remains:
会如此互相吞食，直到剩下唯一一个。

Buffet. In the end, Buffet will be alone, without anyone left to keep them company.
最后应该只有自助餐会留下吧。身边空无一人。

The experiences people pursue are not simply a way to live in the present.
这些人所追求的经验并不只是充足地活在当下。

We want the same taste we've already tasted. The fullness. The pleasure.
曾经感受过的味道、饱腹感。快感。

New experiences are sought so we many feel those old sensations once more.
为了再次感受那些，才会想要经验。

Filled, emptied, then filled again.
填满后又变得空荡，于是再次填满。

That is simply how we were designed. To exist in an endless cycle of yearning for something, anything.
人本就被如此创造，总会不断渴望某物。

Isn't that just too cruel?
不觉得很残酷吗？

To be fated to never know satisfaction.
这样不知满足的命运。

And that is why the Noirs have chosen an everlasting inertness. Do you remember?
所以黑派才会选择停止。记得吗？

It's because they are all afraid.
因为一切都显得可怖啊。

Afraid of death, the Noirs nail themselves inside the memory of the past before death can come to claim them.
因为害怕死亡，所以才将自己固定在死亡来临前的记忆。

Afraid of death, the Rouges continue filling every passing moment with different experiences so they can let go of their selves.
因为害怕死亡，为了忘记死亡去用其他经验填充，从而放弃自我。

Their routes of escape may look worlds apart, but every path stretches infinitely toward the same asymptote.
作为逃避死亡的方法，虽然过程有所不同，但那结果却又近乎一致。

And what is asymptotic...
可相似到极点的事物……

<... is not within human ability to distinguish, you said last time.>
<只要身为人类就无法区分，对吧。>

The world outside the Grand Magasin is no different.
在百货店外也是一样。

Only the process and the form appear different.
不过是过程与形式看似不同而已。

Everyone fears death. Everyone struggles against it in their own way.
大家都害怕死亡，因此都以自己的方式挣扎着。

Once someone has been thrown into the journey of life, death waits at the end of that road.
一旦诞生，那死亡必然在尽头等待。

And along that road, people are made unable to remain satisfied. That is simply the way we were birthed into this world.
而抵达死亡的过程中，人类注定不知满足。只是，生而如此罢了。

Why do you suppose people were made that way? Is there a reason behind it?
你觉得为什么人们被如此创造呢？会不会有什么理由？

But I'm not interested in exploring or rewriting humanity's reason for existence, origin, or design.
不过，我并不想对人类的存在理由或根源，或是设计之类的做些什么。

Instead, it's about letting someone go through the journey of life toward death while remaining true to themselves.
始于诞生，步向死亡的道路……只希望至少在那路上，自己能够成为“自己”。

Now... feeding a hungry child can hardly be called a sin.
那么，虽然喂饱空腹的孩子不能算是罪孽……

But this child will leave nothing behind.
但那孩子应该不会留下任何东西吧。

The gold has been torn away to the final thread.
黄金会被剥至最后一根，

The department store is being flayed bare... its flesh stripped from the bone as depletion closes in.
百货店如同被削去血肉一样……日渐消瘦，逐渐枯竭。

Fullness will remain forever beyond their reach, but we can still tell them...
虽然或许永远无法饱腹，但……

... "Bon appétit."
祝用餐愉快。
